v: EkAraH svaravarRaBedaH edEtO kaRWatAlavyAvityukteH kaRWatAlusTAnayoruccAryyaH । sa ca dIrGaH dvimAtratvAt plutastu trimAtra iti BedaH । dvimAtrasya udAttAnudAttasvaritaBedEH pratyekamanunAsikAnanunAsikaBedAByAYca zaqviDaH evaM plutasyApIti dvAdaSaviDaH । tantre tasya vAcakaSabdA uktA yaTA । “ErlajjA BOtikaH kAntA vAyavI mohinI viBuH । dakzA dAmodaraH prajYo Daro vikftamuKyapi । kzamAtmakojagadyoniH paraH paraniboDakft । jYAnAmftA kaparddiSrIH pIWeSo'gniH samAtfkaH । tripurA lohitA rAjYI vAgBavo BOtikAsanam । maheSvarI dvAdaSI ca vimalaSca sarasvatI । kAmakowo vAmajAnuraMSumAn vijayo jawA” । “EkAraH koWarAkzI ca mAlinyunmattaBEravI” iti ca varRABiDA॰ । mAtfkAnyAse'DarozWe nyasyatvAt tacCabdABiDeyatA । tasya DyeyarUpaM kABaDenuta॰ uktaM yaTA “EkAraM paramaM divyaM mahAkuRqalinIM svayam । kowicandrapratIkASaM paYcaprARamayaM sadA । brahmavizRumayaM varRRaM taTA rudramayaM priye! । sadASivamayaM varRaM vindutrayasamanvitam” । taparatve kAraparatve ca tatsvarUpaparaH ।

v: na॰ ekAgrasya BAvaH । ananyAsaktacittatve ekamAtrAlambicittatve ekAgratASabde vivftirudAharaRaYca ।
m: ऐकाग्र्य n. (fr. एकाग्र), intentness or concentration on one object, MBh.; BhP.; Vedāntas.
a: ऐकाग्र्यं — Intentness on one object.

s: tri, (ekAhe Bavam । ekAha + Wak .) ekAhanizpannam । ekadinAntaraBavam । iti vEdyakam ॥ (vEdyakagopAlakfzRakaviBUzaRakftakazAyasaMgrahe dAsyAdipAcane yaTA । “BUtotTaM vizamaM tridozajajanitaYcEkAhikaM dvyAhikam ॥ “kAkajaNGA balA SyAmA brahmadaRqI kftAYjaliH । pfSniparRI tvapAmArgastaTA BfNgarAjo'zwamaH ॥ ezAmanyatamaM mUlaM puzyeRodDftya yatnataH । raktasUtreRa saMvezwya badDamEkAhikaM jayet” ॥ iti vEdyakacakrapARisaMgrahe jvarADikAre ॥) ekAhaBavam । yaTA, -- “EkAhikaM dvitIyasTaM tftIyakacaturTakam” । ityAdi mAheSvarakavacam ॥
v: tri॰ ekAhamaDIzwoBUtoBftoBAvI vA WaY । 1 ekAhasADye yAgAdO striyAM NIp । tato'ntyAnyEkAhikAni” ASva॰ SrO॰ 8, 16, 16, “tAByAM pUrvve EkAhike” 2, 10, 10, “antyAnAmEkAhikAnAmutta mAn” 2 ekAhavyApake jvarAdO “samudrasyottare tIre dvipadonAma vAnaraH । EkAhikajvaraM hanti tasya nAmAnukorttanAt” । EkAhikajvaraSca ekAhAnantare ekadinaM vyApakojvaraH iti vEdyake prasidDam । ekAhaBfte 3 dAse ekAhamaDIzwe satkftya vyApArite 4 aDyApake svasattayA ekAha vyAptavyakAle 5 ekAhaBAvini utasavAwO ca । ekAhasADyayAgaBeda ekAhaH tasya dakzirA WaY NIp । 6 ekAhasADyayAgadakziRAyAM strI ।
m: ऐकाहिक mf(ई)n. (fr. एकाह), lasting one day, ephemeral, quotidian (as fever), AgP.
belonging to an Ekāha (q.v.) sacrifice, ŚBr.; AitBr.; ĀśvŚr. &c.
a: ऐकाहिक — a. (की f.) 1 Ephemeral. --2 Of one or the same day, quotidian. --3 Lasting for one day (as a sacrifice, fever, festival &c.).

s: puM, (EkAhika ekAhaBavo jvaraH .) ekadinAntarAgatajvaraH । tasyOzaDaM yaTA, -- “pItaM vfScikamUlantu paryyuzitajalena vE । sArdDaM vinASayeddAhaM jvaraYca parameSvara ! ॥ SiKAyAYcEva tadbadDaM BavedEkAhikAdinut । etat sakAYjikaM pItaM raktakuzWajvarAdinut ॥ vAsyodakena pItaM tat vfhadvizaharaM Bavet” । iti gAruqe 193 aDyAyaH ॥ (“EkAhiko dyAhikaSca stryAhikaSca taTAparaH” । “mustAmftAmalakyaSca nAgaraM kaRwakArikA । kaRAcUrRAnvitaH kvATastaTA maDusamanvitaH ॥ EkAhikaM vA velAdyaM jvarajAtaM vyapohati । vAnarendramuKaM divyaM taruRAdityatejasam ॥ jvaramEkAhikaM GoraM tatkzaRAdeva naSyati । vAnarAkftimAliKya KawikABiH punaH SfRu ॥ ganDapuzpAkzatErDUpErarccayedBizajAM varaH” । mantro yaTA, o~ hAM hrIM SrIM sugrIvAya mahAbalaparAkramAya sUryyaputtrAya amitatejase EkAhika-dvyAhikatryAhika-cAturTika-mahAjvara-BUtajvara-BayajvaraSokajvara-kroDajvara-velAjvara-praBftijvarARAM banDa banDa hrAM hrIM hrUM Paw svAhA । iti hArIte cikitsAsTAne । 2 aDyAye ॥)

m: ऐकाह्य n. (fr. id.), the state of an Ekāha (q.v.) sacrifice, ŚāṅkhŚr.

v: tri॰ ekAntamavaSyaM BAvI WaY । 1 avaSyaBavye । “suKasyEkAntikasya ca” manuH । “EkAntikamAtyantikamuBayamApnoti kEbalyam” sAM॰ kA॰ EkAntikamavavaSyaM BAvi” kO॰ । ekAnta BUtaH svasattayA vyApI WaY । 2 ekAntasya svasattayA vyApake “kfzRaSciakAntikaH suhft” BAga॰ 3, 2, striyAM NIp “EkAntikI harerBaktirutpAtAyEva kalpate” varA॰ pu॰ ।
m: ऐकान्तिक mf(ई)n. (fr. एकान्त), absolute, necessary, complete, exclusive, BhP.; Suśr.; Sāṃkhyak. &c.
ऐकान्त्य n. (fr. id.), exclusiveness, absoluteness, Sarvad.

v: tri॰ ekamanyat viparItaM vfttamaDyayane'sya । “karmmADyayane vfttam” pA॰ Wak । yasyADyayane pravfttasya parIkzAkAle viparItoccAraRarUpaM sKalanamekaM jAtam tAdfSe kupAWake CAtre ।
m: ऐकान्यिक mfn. (एकम् अन्यद् विपरीतं वृत्तम् अध्ययने ऽस्य) one who commits a single error in reciting, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 63.
a: ऐकान्यिकः — A pupil who commits one error in reading or reciting (the Vedas).

v: na॰ ekArTasya BAvaH zyaY । ekaSaktyA viSizwekArTopasTApane ekArTIBAve । 1 ekaprayojane ca । “2 paRabanDenEkArTyaM sanDiH” si॰ kO॰ ।
m: ऐकार्थ्य n. (fr. एकार्थ), oneness of aim or intention, Daśar.
oneness or unity of an idea, Pat.
sameness of meaning, Jaim.
a: ऐकार्थ्यं — 1 Sameness of aim or purpose. --2 Consistency in meaning.

m: ऐ—कार m. the letter or sound ऐ.

v: na॰ eka AtmA svarUpaM yasya tasya BAvaH zyaY । 1 Ekye 2 ekasvarUpatve । “taTEkAtmyAnuBAvAnAM vikalparahitaH svayam” BAga॰ 6, 8, 31 । “etezAM SreyaASAse utEkAtmyaM mahAtmani” 7, 13, 39 । “ekAtmyagamanAt sadyaH kaluzAdvipramucyate” BA॰ anu॰ 375 । 3 aBede ca “EkAtmyaM vAsudevasya proktavAnarjjunasya ca” BA॰ A॰ 1 a॰ । ekaAtmA tasya BAvaH । 4 Atmana ekatve EkAtmyavAdaH EkAtatmyavAdI
m: ऐकात्म्य n. (fr. एकात्मन्), unity of the soul, unity of being, oneness, identity, MBh.; BhP.
oneness with the Supreme Spirit, L.
a: ऐकात्म्यं — 1 Unity, unity of soul. --2 Identity, sameness. --3 Oneness with the Supreme Soul.

v: puM strI ekasya tannAmnomunergotrApatyam naqA॰ Paka । ekasyarzergotrApatye striyAM wAp ।
m: ऐकायन m. a descendant of Eka g. नडादि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 99.

v: vi॰ eka + svArTe aR । ekaSabdArTe tatoBavAdyarTe gahA॰ Ca । EkIya ekasambanDini tadBavAdO ca tri॰ ।
m: ऐक mfn. (fr. एक), belonging or relating to one (?), g. गहादि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 138 (not in Kāś.)
a: ऐक — a. Belonging to one.

v: na॰ eko BAvo yasya tasya BAvaH zyaY । ekasvaBAvatve ।
m: ऐकभाव्य n. (fr. एक-भाव, g. ब्राह्मणादि, Pāṇ. v, 1, 124), the state of being one, singleness.
a: ऐकभाव्यं — Singleness of nature or purpose.

m: ऐकभौतिक mfn. (fr. एक-भूत), consisting of one element, Kap.
ऐकध्य n. (fr. एकधा), singleness of time or occurrence
a: ऐकध्यं — Singleness of time or occurrence.

v: avya॰ ekaDA + DAsTAne DyamuY ekaDetyarTe “EkaDyaM ca SrapaRam” kAtyA॰ 14, 3, 24 । “etadEkaDyaM saMgfhya” suSru॰ । tataH svArTe qa । EkaDya tadarTe na॰ “EkaDyena SrapaRam” uktakAtyA॰ sUtraBAzye karkaH ।
m: ऐकध्यम् ind. at once, together, Pāṇ. v, 3, 44; KātyŚr.; Suśr.
ऐकध्य—तस् ind. id., Suśr.
ऐकशालिक mfn. = एक-शालिक, q.v., Pāṇ. v, 3, 110.
ऐकशफ mfn. (fr. एक-शफ), coming from or relating to an animal with uncloven hoofs, Gaut. xvii, 24; Mn. v, 8; Yājñ.; Suśr.
a: ऐकशफ — a. (फी f.) Produced by or relating to animals with uncloven hoofs (as milk &c.); Ms. 5. 8; Y. 1. 170.

m: ऐकशब्द्य n. (fr. एक-शब्द), sameness or identity of words, Jaim.

v: tri॰ ekaSatamasyAsti WaY । ekaSataparimitadravyasvAmini । evamEkasahasrikAdayo'pi tattatsaMKyadravyayukte tri॰ ।
m: ऐकशतिक mfn. (fr. एक-शत), possessing 101 Kāś. on Pāṇ. v, 2, 118.
a: ऐकशतिक — a. (की f.) Provided with 101.

v: na॰ ekA Srutiryatra tasya BAvaH zyaY । “udAttAnudAtta svaritAnAM paraH sannikarza EkaSrutyam” ASva॰ SrO॰ 1, 2 9, sUtrokte svaraBede । ekaSrutiSabde vivftiH Ekasvaryyamapyatra na॰ ।
m: ऐकश्रुत्य n. (fr. एक-श्रुति, q.v.), sameness of tone or accent, monotony, ĀśvŚr., Kāś.
a: ऐकश्रुत्यं, ऐकस्वर्यं — The one accentless monotonous tone, monotony.
ऐकद्यं — ind. At once.

m: ऐकगविक mfn. (fr. एक-गव), possessing but one cow, Pat. on Pāṇ. v, 2, 118.
ऐकगुण्य n. (fr. एक-गुण), the value of a single unit, simple unity, MBh.
ऐककाल्य n. (fr. एक-काल), unity of time, Jaim.
ऐककर्म्य n. (fr. एक-कर्मन्), unity of action, Jaim.
ऐकलव mf(ई)n. (fr. ऐकलव्य, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 111) belonging to a descendant of Eka-lū.

v: puMstrI ekalvaH apatyaM gargA॰ yaY । ekalUnAmakarzergotrApatye striyAM NIp yalopaH EkalavI । Ekalavyasya CAtrAH kaRvA॰ tato'R yalopaH । Ekalava tacCAtrezu striyAM NIp ।
m: ऐकलव्य mf(वी). a descendant of Eka-lū, g. गर्गादि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 105.
ऐकमन्त्र्य n. the having the same Mantras, ĀpŚr., Sch.

v: na॰ ekaM mataM yezAM tezAM BAvaH zyaY । tulyasammatO “svargAmiRastasya tamEkamatyAt” raGuH । “EkamatyaM hi norAjan! sarvezAmeva lakzaye” BA॰ va॰ 7 a॰ । “EkamatyaYca sarvasya janasyATa nfpaM prati” BA॰ va॰ 298 a॰ । “suhfdaScEkamatyAt” BA॰ u॰ 22 a॰ । “kvEkamatyaM mahADiyAm” nItiH । EkamatyamatrAsti ac । Ekamatyayukte tri॰ । “garhetAnyonyamatayo mastriRo bruvate sadA । nacEkamatyaH Sezo'sti mantraH so'Dama ucyate” rAmA॰ ।
m: ऐकमत्य n. (fr. एक-मत), unanimity, conformity or sameness of opinions, MBh.; Ragh.; Rājat. &c.
ऐकमत्य mfn. having conformity of opinions, conforming, agreeing, R. v.
a: ऐकमत्यं — Unanimity, agreement, sameness of opinion; R. 18. 36; अत्र सर्वेषानैकमत्यं H. 1 all are unanimous on this point.

m: ऐकमुख्य n. unanimity, Mcar.

v: tri॰ ekasmin pade sTAne viBaktyante vA BavaH WaY । 1 ekasTAnaBave 2 ekaviBaktyantapadaBave ca । ekapadAya praBavati WaY । “kfto'pyekapadikA Bavanti yaTA vratatirdamUnAH” ityAdi niru॰ “ekArTamanekaSabdamityetaduktam aTa yAnyanekArTAnyekapadAni tAnyato'nukramizyAmo'navagatasaMskArAMSca nigamAn tadEkapadikamityAcakzate iti niru॰ ukte anekaSabde ekArTapare samAsAdivfttirUpe 3 vAkyaBede ca ।
m: ऐकपदिक mfn. (fr. एक-पद), belonging to a simple word, Nir.
consisting of single words, Nir. iv, 1.
a: ऐकपदिक — a. (की f.) 1 Belonging to a simple word. --2 Consisting of single words. --कं The name given to the Naigama section of Yāska's commentary on the Nighaṇṭavas.

v: na॰ ekapadasya ekArTakEkaviBaktyantasya BAvaH zyaY । saMsfzwArTatve anekapAdAnAmekArTaboDakatAsampAdane sasAdiBAve ।
m: ऐकपद्य n. (see the last) unity of words, the state of being one word, Kāś. on Pāṇ. ii, 1, 25.
a: ऐकपद्यं — 1 Unity of words. --2 Being formed into one word.

v: na॰ ekapaterBAvaH karma vA zyaY । sArvaBOmatve “apratidvandvatAmEkapatyaYca sarvadehinAm” BAga॰ 7, 3, 34 । ekapatO BavaH patyuttarapadatvAt Rya । ekapatiBave tri॰ ।
m: ऐकपत्य n. (fr. एक-पति), sovereignty of one, absolute monarchy, BhP.
a: ऐकपत्यं — 1 Sole sovereignty, supreme power. --2 Absolute monarchy.

v: na॰ ekarAjo BAvaH zyaY । cakravarttitve “yatsuparRReyenEkarAjyamajayo hi nA” ASva॰ SrO॰ 5, 19, 4 ।
m: ऐकराज्य अम्, (fr. एक-राज्), sole monarchy, ĀśvŚr. v.
a: ऐकराज्यं — Monarchy.

m: ऐकरात्रिक mfn. (fr. एक-रात्र), staying one night, Gaut.
ऐकरूप्य n. (fr. एक-रूप), the being of one sort, identity, Sāh.
ऐकसहस्रिक mfn. (fr. एक-सहस्र), possessing 1001.
a: ऐकसहस्रिक — a. (की f.) Provided with 1001.

m: ऐकस्वर्य n. (fr. एक-स्वर), the state of having but one accent (as of a compound), Kāś. on Pāṇ. ii, 1, 25
sameness of tone, monotony, ŚāṅkhŚr.
ऐकवर्णिक mfn. (fr. एक-वर्ण), relating to one caste, MBh.
ऐक्यारोप m. equalization, Kuv.

s: klI, (eka + BAve zyaY .) ekasya BAvaH । ekatA । ekatvam । ekIBAvaH । yaTA । SAradAyAm । “gurorllabDvA punarvvidyAmazwakftvo japet suDIH । guruvidyAdevatAnAmEkyaM samBAvayan DiyA ॥ praRameddaRqavadBUmO guruM taM devatAtmakam” । iti dIkzAtattvam ॥
v: na॰ ekasya BAvaH zyaY । 1 ekatve 2 aBinnatve 3 ekArTI BAve ca “dEkyaM so'nvaye” mugDa॰ “EkyasaMyoganAnAtva samavAyaviSAradaH” BA॰ sa॰ 5 a॰ । 4 Ekamatye sOhArde ca “tezAM dvayordvayorEkya biBede na kaTaYcana” raGuH । ekasyApatyaM gargA॰ yaY । ekApatye puMstrI॰ striyAM NIp yalopa EkI ।
m: ऐक्य n. (fr. एक), oneness, unity, harmony, sameness, identity, MBh.; Ragh.; Sarvad. &c.
identity of the human soul or of the universe with the Deity, MW.
an aggregate, sum, Sūryas.
(in math.) the product of the length and depth of excavations differing in depth.
a: ऐक्यं — 1 Oneness, unity, harmony; R. 10. 82; U. 6. 33. --2 Unanimity. --3 Identity, sameness. --4 Especially, the identity of the human soul or of the universe with the Deity. --5 An aggregate, whole. --6 (In alg.) The product of the length and depth of the portions or little excavations differing in depth (Colebrooke).

KArjUraMtAlamEkzavam । mAkzikaM wANkamADvIkamEreyaM nArikelajam । samAnAni vijAnIyAnmadyAnyekAdaSEva tu । dvAdaSantu surAmadyaM sarvvezAmaDamaM smftam” pulastyaH । madyAnyekAdaSetyuktiH aDikadozArTA anyezAmapi madyAnAM madanapAlena darSitatvAt । prasaNgAt tAnyatra guRasahitAni darSyante । “madyaM hAlA surA SuRqA madirA varuRAtmajA । irA ganDottaBA kalyA devaspfzwA ca vAruRI । madyaM pittakara Sasyate । bala puzwikaraM madyaM raktArSohAri dIpanam । mADvIkalya guRaM kiYcit 2 KArjUramanilapradam । tadeva viSadaM rucyaM SlezmaGnaM karzaRaM laGu । SAlizazwikapizwAdikftaM madyaM surA 3 matA । Sotaraso mataH । sIGuH pakvarasaH SrezWaH smarAgnibalavarRakft । vAtapittakaro hfdyasnehano rocano jayet । vibanDamehaSoTArSaHSoTodara kaPAmayAn । tasmAdalpaguRaH SItarasaH saMleKanaH smftaH । jAmbavaH kzOdrasamBUtaH jambUrasaguqodBavaH । jAmbavo 21 badDanizyandaH kazAyo'nilakopanaH । arizwAsaMvasIDUnAM guRAn karmmARi cAdiSet । budDvA yaTAsvaM saMskAramavekzya kuSalo Bizak । sAndraM vidAhi durganDi virasaM kfmisaNkulam । ahfdyaM taruRaM rUkzamuzRaM durBojane hitam । alpOzaDaM paryyuzitamatyarTapicCalaYca yat । kaPaprakopi tanmadyaM durjaraYca viSezataH । pittaprakopi bahulaM tokzRamuzRaM vidAhi ca । ahfdyaM peSalaM pUtikfmilaM virasaM guru । taTA paryuzitaM vApi vindyAdanilakopanam । sarvvadozErupetantu sarvvadozaprakopaRam । cirasTitaM yAtarasaM dIpanaM kaPavAtajit ।
